name: com.seikasan.entities-jobify
description: Analyzes SystemAPI.Query loops in ISystem.OnUpdate and offers Rider quick fixes that convert supported loops to IJobEntity.Run(), Schedule(), or ScheduleParallel().

samples.description: A two-component SystemAPI.Query loop that can be converted to run synchronously or scheduled sequentially or in parallel.
A movement query with branches, vector arithmetic, and tag filters.
